ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the leading edges and central peduncle versus 55% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the interior lobe surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity bands track the leading margins (superior 30% of visible fluke area). Stochastic high-contrast mottling and focal black spots are concentrated at the horizontal transition zones between dark leading edges and light interior fields. High-intensity fields occupy the central and inferior regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertical axis of symmetry.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory along the leading edges, tapering to high-contrast distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast clusters of white/beige calcified masses (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, vertical, parallel dark linear pixel streaks are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations on both distal tips; small localized dark-pixel pits on the medial portion of the left lobe white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency 'peppered' pixel distribution at the interface between the black leading edge pigment and the white ventral surface.
